title: Best Landscape Designers Online (2026): Garden and Yard Plans
description: How to hire an online landscape designer for garden, yard or patio plans: site info, plants, drawings, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Online landscape designers plan gardens, yards, patios and outdoor spaces from your photos, measurements and wishes. They create layouts, planting plans, material suggestions and sometimes 3D views. A good plan fits your climate, soil, sun and budget. Projects go wrong when measurements are wrong, plants do not suit the local climate, or plans include structures that need permits or engineering. This guide helps you get a garden plan you can actually build.

faq.q: Can a designer plan my garden remotely?
faq.a: Yes, with good photos, accurate measurements and information about sun, soil and climate.

faq.q: Will I get a planting list?
faq.a: Ask for one with plant names, quantities and spacing.
Retaining walls, decks, drainage changes and some structures may need permits or professional engineering. Check local rules.
Yes. Tell them how much time you can spend on the garden.
Usually remote designers provide plans; local contractors or you do the work.
